string_step_plans.law: Batch 1 step plans (Torch LP1/RP2-only strings, 2026-10-25). Engine: fighter.js _attackClipPlan step-plan branch (from #1096). A step plays its row ONLY when status is verified (button bitmask + stance + throw gates pass, plus the Job 1 limb-peak proxy except in jump context). review/unmapped steps play NO bank row - never a donor/generic row - and are flagged in _atkPlan.unmapped. T3 rows here are FALLBACK (see docs/anim/PROCEDURAL_AUDIT.md Torch-Batch-1 entry): torch's T3 moves carry TWO banks - jin (145 moves) and anna (224 moves) - and every step adjudicates against ITS OWN move's bank (prefix move t3_source, else first-step move t3_source). File-level t3_source is jin and t3_bank is moveset_jin.json on BOTH #1096 and main, but that is NEVER assumed for all moves. Torch is the FIRST dual-bank fighter in the pipeline (the other 9 T7-block fighters are single-bank). Pack dir = bank name for BOTH banks (no diablo-style split). Pack banks: divmot09_jin.bin (jin), divmot17_anna.bin (anna). BOUND BANK (engine fact, fighter.js #1096 FIGHTER_BANK override torch->anna + moveset anim_bank anna): torch plays from the ANNA bank in game. The #1096 step-plan branch resolves row:N against the bound bank ONLY, with no per-step bank guard - unlike _ownRow / _rowDonor, which refuse another bank's rows outright. Therefore jin-bank gate-verified steps are BANK-BLOCKED: status review, row null, bank_verified_row preserved on the step + in reasons. Wiring them as verified would play anna row N - a wrong-bank clip - so they are NOT wired as playable. Promotion needs per-step-bank engine support; the verification evidence is preserved so promotion is mechanical, no re-adjudication. Anna-bank gate-verified steps wire normally (verified + row) and ARE playable via the #1096 engine path. Jin-bank rules, per-bank evidence (freshly derived here, never copied from demonio/kinpo/scimitar): row 35 EXISTS (starts-airborne, btn 1, hf [11,12,39,535,0,1], level m) - airborne, fails ground steps; row 220 EXISTS (standing RP2, btn 2, hf [12,12,41,1042,0,2], level h) - torch RP2 move 2's own row; row 216 EXISTS (jump, btn 0, hf [63,64,117,1543,0,0], level u) - fails every single-button gate. Jin row 248 (torch LP1 move 1's own row) is STANDING but button 12 (multi-button clip, hf [13,15,51,535,0,12]) - it FAILS every single-LP1 step under exact-equality (demonio row 177 btn-12 + scimitar row 184 btn-9 precedent). Jin row 184 (btn 9) likewise. Anna-bank rules, per-bank evidence (first-ever anna adjudication): row 35 EXISTS (starts-airborne, btn 1, hf [9,9,37,535,0,1], level m) - airborne, fails ground steps; row 220 EXISTS in hit_frames ([19,24,74,535,0,0], button 0) but is ABSENT from Job 1 - fails every single-button gate, no stance profile; row 216 EXISTS in hit_frames ([14,14,58,271,0,0], button 0) but is ABSENT from Job 1 - same treatment. Torch basics (both files, unchanged): LP1 move 1 jin r248 (damage 7), RP2 move 2 jin r220 (damage 10), LK3 move 3 jin r195 (damage 14), RK4 move 4 jin r199 (damage 15). Re-baseline #1096 vs current main: moves + strings deep-equal; only top-level diff is main's added t7_motbin section. Row-changed 0, damage-only 0, damage-differs 0 - suspended-drift steps 0. Torch was NEVER purged by #1039 (t8_quarantine_20261024 key ABSENT on both files) - no #988 dependency. Gap-1: jin hit_frames IDENTICAL, skeleton IDENTICAL, rows.pack ADDITIVE-ONLY drift (all 220 b1096 rows present unchanged on main; main adds 6 rows 89/112/247/288/339/357; 0 changed, 0 removed - affected fills 0; no Batch 1 candidate is a main-only row). Anna: all three blobs IDENTICAL - zero drift. Every wired row is present in the current main anna pack. GATE-ONLY batch: Job 2 torch entries 0, Job 3 torch entries 0, job3.log torch lines 0 - Job 3 fills 0 and Job 4 joins 0 by data absence (bank-level Job 4 candidates jin 47 / anna 45 exist but cannot join without Job 2 torch entries; a join never promotes anyway). No SOFT fill inherited from #1097 (Pantera-specific, unapproved). Standing rows verified for crouch-context steps (d/f+1+2,2 step 2 anna row 174; d+1+2 family jin rows 92/93/183 BANK-BLOCKED) follow the demonio Batch 1 precedent: the pipeline stance gate flags crouch rows for non-crouch steps, not standing rows for crouch steps (GATE-NOTE on each such step; re-adjudicate if the gate tightens). Canonicalization is the CORRECTED rule (strip only a trailing ~t[378] source-variant suffix): Torch Batch 1 contains ZERO input-~ canonicals. File-wide there is exactly ONE input-~ comma key, d+4,1~4 (T8 Anna Sudden Severe Drop, buttons LP1+RK4 - Batch 3/4 scope, not Batch 1). Most unmapped steps have NO candidate at all (45 of 65 planned): their intermediate prefixes are T8-sourced with no T3 row, so the correct clips come from #988 Step 2 (original T8 refs) or future extraction, never from a T3 row recorded as correct. Full gate evidence in docs/movesets/TORCH-BATCH1-STEP-PLANS-2026-10-25.md.

canon_wiring.note: Additive canon wiring for the Move List Creator. canon_moves entries are NEW entries; no Tekken moves entry was replaced or overwritten. Existing entries gained only an anim_ref field where one was missing. wh: refs are placeholders for animations not yet authored (see canon file header); made: refs are wiring labels pending the sibling animation lane clips. NOT play-verified.

t7_motbin.method: Additive wiring: this section is NEW. No existing moveset entry was modified, reordered, or deleted. Existing playable moves keep their current anim_ref; motbin internal moves are NOT joined to playable input keys by name similarity, and no .mvl display walk was performed in this batch, so no existing anim_ref was overwritten on a guess. A future input-key join must be walk-verified from the cancel tables below.
t7_motbin.anim_ref_format: t7mot:<code>:0xXXXX where XXXX is the exact anim_ref from mot.bin; bank = anim_ref & 0xC000; clip_key = anim_ref - bank
t7_motbin.cancel_note: String continuations are ONLY these cancel rows from the file. move_id >= 0x8000 is an alias reference, not a move index, and must not be resolved silently. Runtime input keys stay 1/2/3/4; input_lp is display only (1=LP1, 2=RP2, 3=LK3, 4=RK4).
t7_motbin.damage_note: damage here is the motbin hit_condition damage for the move; it is NOT MOD damage and does NOT replace any existing t7.damage in this file.
t7_motbin.clip_blocker: 0x8000-bank clip bytes: the 0x8000 MOTA block is not present in tkdata repo files; clip bytes live only in pakchunk archives / live-game memory, which this Linux VM without GPU cannot run. Those moves carry clip_status BLOCKER_MAIN_MOTA_NOT_IN_TKDATA; their key is recorded, bytes were not guessed. 0x0000/0x4000 rows carry SOURCE_IDENTIFIED_BYTES_UNRESOLVED: source identified by bank, byte offsets not resolved in this batch.
t7_motbin.editor_note: Loader/editor consumption of this section (Move List Creator) is a follow-up for the game-code lane; this PR wires the data into the file at the correct integration point without rewriting game code.
